sql: select ep.epoch_number, ep.started_at as epoch_started, ep.ended_at as epoch_ended, ep.platform_snapshot_id as snap, d.deployment_key, d.ended_at as dep_ended, da.strategy_tag from experiment_epochs ep join experiment_versions v on v.id = ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id left join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id = ep.id left join experiment_deployment_arms da on da.deployment_id = d.id where e.key = 'mmsell-price-ceiling' and v.version = 1 order by ep.epoch_number, d.deployment_key, da.strategy_tag
